dogecoin.text:
I brought a little DogeCoin, but own a lot more Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP. 

I am a pretty traditional investor. 

I really like to understand before I put money into something.

DogeCoin has returned 13,000 % return on investment in the past six months.

So $1,000 invested in October would be valued around 130-140K today 🤯 

It started as a joke, got hype from influencers, and people are buying in.

The Laws of Supply & Demand

What are you thoughts?
